control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - management of change not applied to P-4101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4101, P-4105 and TK-4211 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4101 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 10 May 2018 a planned critical control verification of P-4101, P-4105 and TK-4211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment not effective.
